headline: Stalled Firmus IPO Raises Uncertainty Over AI Data Center Buildouts
summary: Australian data center company Firmus stalled its public float attempt, putting billions of dollars in AI chip buy commitments in doubt.
why: Data center developers provide essential capital and infrastructure required to house next-generation artificial intelligence hardware.

impacts.name: AI Data Centers
impacts.why: A stalled IPO creates execution risks for financing large-scale hardware orders.
